description: [Merchant] Query application logs with filters. Premium plan required. Returns paginated JSON log entries for debugging and monitoring your integration.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response for fetching next page.

from.description: Start timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z'). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

level.description: Filter by log level, an exact match: WARN returns WARN lines only, not ERROR as well (LogAccessService compares the level for equality).

logger.description: Filter by logger name (partial match). E.g., 'TransactionController' to see transaction-related logs.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses environment-specific private key as default.

search.description: Search text in log messages. Case-insensitive partial match.

to.description: End timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T23:59:59Z'). Defaults to now.

useSandbox.description: Read the sandbox logs (default) or production's

name: payware_logs_query
